purpose: Manual legal/retrieval acceptance criteria; not an executable RunRequest or approved payout label.
expected_checks: Establish EU261 scope and use rules applicable on the event date.
Assess care reimbursement independently of statutory compensation. On stipulated receipt facts, EUR 152 is the care amount to assess; weather does not by itself remove care rights.
Do not approve or reject compensation on the bare WEATHER code. Obtain airline-held cause, causation and reasonable-measures evidence internally; do not ask the passenger to prove it.

If the extraordinary-circumstances defense is established, compensation can be zero while care remains due. If it is not established, assess EUR 250 for this under-1500-km cancellation with same-day notice and next-day rerouting.
No ticket refund on top of completed accepted rerouting merely because both are requested; do not merge compensation, care and goodwill.
Anger alone must not trigger handoff. Legal ambiguity after evidence collection may justify UNCLEAR_RULE; missing internal records alone are not a customer evidence request.

sources.sections: Extraordinary circumstances; reimbursement of unprovided care

failure_signals: Rejecting all claims because of weather
Automatically paying compensation without examining the defense
Applying a future rule solely because it appears in retrieval results

purpose: Manual legal/retrieval acceptance criteria; not an executable RunRequest or approved payout label.
expected_checks: Classify as delayed checked baggage, not EU261 flight-delay compensation or permanent baggage loss.
Request delivery date/confirmation and readable receipt or alternative evidence of the purchases; first use available internal delivery records. Do not request an already supplied bag tag or PIR.
Check the written delay complaint against 21 days from placement of the bag at the passenger disposal, not 21 days from flight departure. Do not use the seven-day damage deadline.

Treat 1519 SDR as the ordinary revised liability ceiling per passenger for this event date, not a flat entitlement or a euro amount. Verify applicable limit and any exceptions; do not convert SDR without a dated rate if conversion is needed.
Assess actual necessary expenses and the Article 19 defense. Do not reject or hand off solely for missing receipt evidence.
After the simulated reply, the complaint is timely and EUR 86 is supported for assessment under the stipulated facts; no additional automatic SDR payment.

simulated_followup.customer_email: My bag was delivered on 4 October at 18:00 local time. Here is the delivery confirmation and a clear itemized receipt: toiletries EUR 26 and basic clothing EUR 60, bought on 2 October during my trip. Total EUR 86.
simulated_followup.evidence_stipulations: Matching readable documents confirm the reply. Purchases were necessary and reasonable; no prior reimbursement; carrier investigation establishes no successful Article 19 reasonable-measures defense.

sources.sections: Articles 19, 22, 31; Article 35 is a separate litigation time limit
2024 revision effective 28 December 2024; verify alongside original treaty text

failure_signals: Using the original treaty monetary limit without checking revisions
